mcpServer.name: my-documents
mcpServer.instructions: Access your personal document knowledge base

tools.name: rag_search
tools.description: Semantic search across your personal knowledge base. Use for fuzzy/topical questions like "what's been said about X?" Query must be PLAIN WORDS — no field:value syntax.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Lucene search for specific documents by title, tag, content, date, or series. Returns lean summaries - call get_document on a result's id to fetch its full text.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Fetch a document's contents by its UUID. Returns the canonical body full_text (polished version) plus summary, tags, and date. Set include_stage_outputs: true to inspect intermediate pipeline stages.
